prompt: After dress rehearsal, the director (say / tell) us not to wear squeaky trainers near the side microphones during the silent garden scene.
explanation_ru: После глагола tell (в отличие от say) ставится прямое дополнение (us) и инфинитив с частицей to.

prompt: The printed card next to the kettle (say / tell) guests how to twist the old brass front-door key twice and where to find spare blankets for rainy evenings.
explanation_ru: В конструкции «глагол + дополнение (guests) + вопросительное слово + инфинитив» используется глагол tell.

prompt: Our museum security instructions (say / tell) that all candidates must bring one photo ID to the gate and avoid the main stairs because of wet paint.
explanation_ru: После глагола say (в отличие от tell) придаточное предложение с союзом that вводится напрямую, без указания адресата.

prompt: The sign beside the cloakroom (say / tell) visitors why large backpacks must go in free lockers and reminds them to switch off camera flashes near old prints.
explanation_ru: Глагол tell требует после себя прямое дополнение (visitors), за которым следует придаточное предложение с why.

prompt: The large board at the entrance (say / tell) how to exchange paper tickets for cloth wristbands and reminds visitors to leave glass bottles in the car.
explanation_ru: Когда адресат (кому сообщается информация) не указан перед оборотом how to do something, используется глагол say.

prompt: The cheerful bookmark handed out to every pupil clearly (say / tell) them how to renew graphic novels online and return overdue books without stress.
explanation_ru: После глагола tell идёт прямое дополнение (them) и придаточное с how to, тогда как say не используется в конструкции «say someone how to».

prompt: Before letting visitors touch the static electricity globe, Lin carefully (say / tell) everyone to take off metal rings and stand on the rubber mat.
explanation_ru: В конструкции «глагол + дополнение (everyone) + инфинитив с to» для передачи указания используется tell, а не say.

prompt: When my soaked parcel finally arrived, the delivery driver apologetically (say / tell) that the van roof had been leaking all morning.
explanation_ru: После глагола say сразу следует придаточное с that без указания собеседника; глагол tell в такой позиции требует дополнения.

prompt: Pointing past the wooden bridge, the race marshal urgently (say / tell) the cyclists to slow down for wet gravel and follow the orange ribbons.
explanation_ru: Конструкция «tell + кому (the cyclists) + to + инфинитив» используется для передачи предупреждений и инструкций.

prompt: The neat printed card next to the router (say / tell) to press the grey button for five seconds if the balcony Wi-Fi signal slows down.
explanation_ru: Когда не указано лицо, которому адресована инструкция (нет дополнения после глагола), используется конструкция say to do something.

prompt: Declan stared helplessly at the complicated Japanese rail fare map on the wall. Fortunately, a smiling station attendant came over and (speak / talk) clear, slow English so Declan could understand every word. She also (say / tell) him which platform to use and drew two green arrows on his ticket.
explanation_ru: С названиями языков употребляется глагол speak (spoke English), а перед косвенным дополнением (him) и вопросительным словом (which) ставится tell.

prompt: At the rental desk, the clerk unfolded a paper road map and highlighted two orange turns. She (say / tell) us how to leave the airport roundabout without entering the toll lane. Before handing over the keys, she also (say / tell) that roadworks near the tunnel might add ten minutes to the trip.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске после глагола стоит дополнение us, поэтому нужен глагол tell; во втором дополнения нет, поэтому перед that используется say.

prompt: Hey everyone, I just spoke to the examiner after class about tomorrow's test. She (say / tell) that we are allowed to bring plain paper dictionaries into the hall. However, she (say / tell) me to check the covers first so no loose notes are tucked inside.
explanation_ru: После say сразу идёт придаточное предложение с that без адресата, тогда как tell требует дополнения (me) перед инфинитивом с to.

prompt: A weathered wooden notice at the start of the trail gives strict advice for summer hikers. It (say / tell) walkers to carry at least two litres of water per person and wear sturdy closed shoes. The bottom line also (say / tell) that everyone must stay inside the marked stone path.
explanation_ru: В конструкции «глагол + дополнение (walkers) + to-инфинитив» используется tell, а перед придаточным с that без указания адресата ставится say.

prompt: Before leaving for lunch, Hugo left a sticky note on the counter for the afternoon shift. His note (say / tell) us to lock the side delivery gate and print the remaining labels before four. At the bottom, he underlined a red warning that (say / tell) not to unplug the freezer alarm under any circumstances.
explanation_ru: Если после глагола есть дополнение (us) перед инфинитивом, выбираем tell; если дополнения нет и сразу идёт отрицательный инфинитив (not to unplug), используется say.

prompt: Lotte stands beside the bike path holding a polite cardboard sign. She (1: say/tell/speak/talk) cyclists to take the parallel lane while the film crew sets up. The sign also (2: say/tell/speak/talk) that cameras will roll for ninety seconds. Finally, Lotte (3: say/tell/speak/talk) to everyone in a calm voice, asking them to pause their bells.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске используется tell + дополнение + to-infinitive (tells cyclists to take). Во втором — say + придаточное с that (says that...). В третьем — speak/talk + to + человек (speaks/talks to everyone).

prompt: Before we arrived, the host ___ there were ninety steep stone steps from the bus stop to the front gate, and she was completely right.
explanation_ru: После глагола tell обязательно указывается адресат без предлога (told us that...), тогда как say употребляется без прямого дополнения лица.

prompt: Just as the ferry's boarding horn blasted overhead, Soren got a call about his job interview and had to ask the caller to ___ louder.
explanation_ru: Для описания громкости или манеры речи (speak louder) используется непереходный глагол speak (или talk) без прямого дополнения.

prompt: During the concert, the cheerful drummer ___ he had accidentally left his drumsticks in a taxi and had to borrow two wooden spoons.
explanation_ru: Если не указано, кому именно адресованы слова, для передачи косвенной речи используется глагол say (said he had left...).

prompt: A laminated sign beside the parcel scanner ___ customers how to show their six-digit pickup code, yet people still tap their bus cards on it.
explanation_ru: Конструкция tell + лицо + how to do something (tells customers how to show) используется для объяснения порядка действий.

prompt: In the post-race interview, the sprint captain told that she nearly dropped the silver baton when a sudden gust blew her cap across lane three.
answer: In the post-race interview, the sprint captain said that she nearly dropped the silver baton when a sudden gust blew her cap across lane three.
accepted_answers: In the post-race interview, the sprint captain said that she nearly dropped the silver baton when a sudden gust blew her cap across lane three.
In the post-race interview, the sprint captain told reporters that she nearly dropped the silver baton when a sudden gust blew her cap across lane three.
explanation_ru: После глагола tell нельзя сразу ставить придаточное с that без указания слушателя; в таких случаях используется глагол said.

prompt: Pointing at the blue validator box, Karim told passengers to tap their paper passes before boarding and keep their backpacks off the door sensors.
answer: Pointing at the blue validator box, Karim told passengers to tap their paper passes before boarding and keep their backpacks off the door sensors.
accepted_answers: Pointing at the blue validator box, Karim told passengers to tap their paper passes before boarding and keep their backpacks off the door sensors.
explanation_ru: Предложение построено верно: глагол tell корректно сочетается с дополнением и инфинитивом с частицей to (told passengers to tap).

prompt: A bold poster by the exam room door says students to write their candidate numbers in blue ink only and leave pencil cases on the windowsill.
answer: A bold poster by the exam room door tells students to write their candidate numbers in blue ink only and leave pencil cases on the windowsill.
accepted_answers: A bold poster by the exam room door tells students to write their candidate numbers in blue ink only and leave pencil cases on the windowsill.
explanation_ru: Глагол say не используется в модели «глагол + дополнение + to-инфинитив» для передачи инструкций; здесь требуется tells (tells students to write).

prompt: You want to explain how the laminated card beside the office water cooler gives staff instructions about lunch boxes and milk cartons. Which sentence is correct?
options: The card says staff how to rinse lunch boxes and label milk cartons with the date.
The card tells staff how to rinse lunch boxes and label milk cartons with the date.
The card speaks staff how to rinse lunch boxes and label milk cartons with the date.
The card talks to staff how to rinse lunch boxes and label milk cartons with the date.
explanation_ru: Только глагол tell образует грамматически верную конструкцию с прямым дополнением и вопросительным словом + инфинитив (tells staff how to rinse).

prompt: Rewrite the sentence using 'tells' instead of 'explains': The handwritten welcome card explains to guests how to switch on the solar water heater and lock the garden shutters at night.
answer: The handwritten welcome card tells guests how to switch on the solar water heater and lock the garden shutters at night.
accepted_answers: The handwritten welcome card tells guests how to switch on the solar water heater and lock the garden shutters at night.
explanation_ru: При замене explains to guests на tells предлог to опускается, так как глагол tell требует прямого дополнения без предлога (tells guests how to...).
